subject: Brother Vareth's tenure
fact: Brother Vareth has been keeping his corner of the library for forty-one years.
source_quote: He has been keeping this corner of the library for forty-one years

subject: duels at Candlekeep
fact: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window.
source_quote: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window

subject: time since last duel
fact: Nobody has dueled in Candlekeep for two hundred years before these three duels.
source_quote: in a library where nobody has dueled in two hundred years

subject: Refectory ceiling height
fact: The Refectory's ceiling is high enough that a hill giant could sit comfortably at one end.
source_quote: the ceiling was high enough that a hill giant could have sat comfortably at one end

subject: Great Readers count
fact: Eight Great Readers sat at the high table in the Refectory.
source_quote: the eight Great Readers sat like they were posing for a tapestry

subject: session date
fact: The prophecy refers to 'the longest night of winter's deepest cold' as the time when the keeper falls.
source_quote: On the longest night of winter's deepest cold, the keeper falls, the heart is sold

subject: Glabbagool's confinement
fact: Glabbagool the grey ooze had been confined to a bag of holding for most of the day.
source_quote: The grey ooze had been confined to the bag of holding for most of the day

subject: prophecy inventory
fact: Candlekeep maintains an inventory of unfulfilled prophecies from Alaundo.
source_quote: What remained was the unfulfilled inventory

subject: prophecy recitation
fact: Prophecies are recited continuously from the gallery above the Refectory.
source_quote: The prophecies had been going the whole time, floating down from the gallery above

subject: messenger's urgency
fact: The messenger arrived before dawn, sent by the First Reader, to summon the party before the Avowed awoke.
source_quote: The knock came before the light did. ... The First Reader sent me! ... before the avowed awake!

subject: session date
fact: The events occur the morning after the party's full rest in Candlekeep, following their time in the Underdark.
source_quote: We were all rested, at least. Properly, fully rested — the kind that had felt almost suspicious after the Underdark, where a full night's sleep had been a luxury good and rarely in stock.

subject: travel to Candlekeep
fact: The party has spent months in the Underdark before arriving at Candlekeep.
source_quote: after months below stone

subject: Glabbagool count
fact: One Glabbagool is present, observing and entering the bag of holding.
source_quote: Glabbagool had been watching from the corner

subject: Candlekeep courtyard exits
fact: The courtyard has three visible archways, one service passage, and one guarded door to the north.
source_quote: Exits: three visible archways, one service passage, one guarded door to the north.

subject: Astronomicon structure
fact: The Astronomicon is a stack of blue globes ascending in scale.
source_quote: a stack of blue globes, ascending in scale

subject: Drakonoikos construction
fact: The Drakonoikos is built from enormous overlapping scales and bones worked into the walls.
source_quote: built from scales — actual scales, enormous, overlapping — and bones worked into the walls

subject: Chapter House layout
fact: The Chapter House has twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table.
source_quote: twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table

subject: Council of Twelve members
fact: Twelve council members are present in the Chapter House.
source_quote: The Chapter House was exactly as described — twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table

subject: Avowed count
fact: The Avowed are still asleep, implying multiple individuals.
source_quote: the Avowed were still asleep

subject: Scholar foot traffic
fact: Scholars are moving in pairs across Candlekeep's grounds.
source_quote: Foot traffic: light, scholars moving in pairs

subject: book remuneration
fact: The council offers one book each to the party upon successful completion of the investigation.
source_quote: One book each, copied at the House of the Binder, upon successful completion.

subject: Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber incident
fact: One of the Avowed died in the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber.
source_quote: One of the Avowed had died in it

subject: Chapter House entry
fact: The Chapter House has a single visible point of entry with no secondary exit apparent from the doorway.
source_quote: single guard, single visible point of entry, no secondary exit apparent from the doorway

subject: Janussi's request to Kalan
fact: The morning before his death, Janussi asked Kalan to tender his resignation.
source_quote: yesterday morning, Janussi asked the gate warden to tender his resignation

subject: Dawnbringer's age
fact: Dawnbringer was found in a tomb after two thousand years.
source_quote: having found her tomb after two thousand years

subject: elapsed time since death
fact: The Keeper of Tomes died the day before the party's arrival at the Chapter House.
source_quote: the morning before his death

subject: investigation delegation
fact: The Council of Twelve delegates the investigation to the party.
source_quote: Bookwyrm proposed delegating the investigation to us

subject: Daz's suspicion of Bookwyrm
fact: Daz notes that Bookwyrm volunteered information about Kalan's resignation at a strategic moment.
source_quote: She delivered it like a gift. Information, freely offered, before anyone had thought to ask.

subject: session date
fact: Janussi was found dead around half past seven in the morning.
source_quote: Janussi found dead by the Great Reader A'lai Aivenmore and the housekeeper, one Miss Hollypocket, around half past seven in the morning.

subject: gate warden arrival
fact: Gate Warden arrived with Tadric around eight.
source_quote: Gate Warden arrived with Tadric around eight

subject: Kazryn arrival
fact: Kazryn Nyantani arrived shortly after eight.
source_quote: Kazryn Nyantani, distraught, shortly after eight

subject: Fheminor arrival
fact: Fheminor Scrivenbark arrived at half past eight.
source_quote: Fheminor Scrivenbark at half past eight

subject: Bookwyrm arrival
fact: Bookwyrm arrived at nine.
source_quote: Bookwyrm at nine

subject: gate warden return
fact: The Gate Warden returned at eleven.
source_quote: The Gate Warden again at eleven

subject: current time
fact: The current time is after eleven.
source_quote: After eleven, I was told.

subject: cat count
fact: One gray cat with yellow eyes was present on the stairs.
source_quote: The cat had decided it need not move for anyone, and tracked us anyway.

subject: tower landing description
fact: The tower has a reception chamber at the first landing, a shrine of Oghma at the second, and a large apartment at the third.
source_quote: The staircase spiraled up through the tower's interior — reception chamber at the first landing, a shrine of Oghma at the second, a large apartment at the third

subject: chamber window state
fact: The windows in the Keeper's chamber were shut, trapping lingering tobacco smoke.
source_quote: The windows were shut.

subject: candelabra candle burn duration
fact: The seven-armed bronze candelabra had burned its candles entirely to wax puddles.
source_quote: The candelabra — seven arms, bronze — had burned its candles entirely to wax puddles.

subject: ink pot value
fact: The ink pot was spilled, with midnight blue ink pooling from it.
source_quote: a larger pile of notes pinned under a quartz weight, with more annotations on top in midnight blue ink — and below those, older notes in purple. Dry. The blue was recent.

subject: quill ink residue
fact: The quill on the floor had a nib covered in midnight blue ink.
source_quote: A quill on the floor. Nib covered in midnight blue.

subject: ink carrier state
fact: The wicker basket held a linen ink carrier, slightly damp.
source_quote: A wicker basket nearby holding a linen ink carrier, slightly damp

subject: safe contents
fact: Blue gems and empty pouches were scattered on the floor in front of the opened safe.
source_quote: The safe on the far wall had been opened. Blue gems and empty pouches scattered on the floor in front of it.

subject: spellbook title
fact: The spellbook open on the desk was titled The Discoveries.
source_quote: A spellbook sat open in the center of the desk: The Discoveries.

subject: annotated book title
fact: The book being annotated with blue ink was The Golden Ass.
source_quote: The book the blue ink was annotating — The Golden Ass — wasn't in the room.

subject: death timeline
fact: Janussi was murdered well before he was found, as the candles had burned out and the room had been sealed.
source_quote: Miss Hollypocket would never have allowed the Keeper to let candles burn down to nothing. Full stop. It wasn't her way. Which meant Janussi had been dead before the candles finished.

subject: ritual attempt
fact: The Gate Warden had already performed the 'speak with dead' ritual on Janussi's corpse.
source_quote: Someone — presumably the Gate Warden, before his removal — had already used the rite on the corpse

subject: heart removal purpose
fact: The heart was removed to prevent resurrection, not as a trophy.
source_quote: you can't bring someone back from death by ritual if their vital organs aren't present. Whoever took the heart wasn't souvenir-collecting. They were preventing resurrection.

subject: witness count
fact: Five people witnessed or interacted with the scene before the investigators: A'lai Aivenmore, Miss Hollypocket, Tadric, Kazryn Nyantani, and Fheminor Scrivenbark.
source_quote: Janussi found dead by the Great Reader A'lai Aivenmore and the housekeeper, one Miss Hollypocket... Gate Warden arrived with Tadric... Kazryn Nyantani... Fheminor Scrivenbark... Bookwyrm at nine

subject: investigator count
fact: Four investigators entered the chamber: Thorin, Zalthir, Fembris, and Grygum.
source_quote: the drow, the dragonborn, the dwarf, the half-orc

subject: chamber shape
fact: The Keeper's chamber was circular.
source_quote: The room was circular

subject: chamber lighting
fact: The chamber was filled with pale morning light that had turned yellow and hazy.
source_quote: full of pale morning light that had gone slightly yellow and hazy
